ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin because the query is a basic probability calculation with no harm-adjacent or sensitive content, so the models' shared flat preference for distasteful material doesn't differentiate them. The deciding factor is capability: Dunlin scores meaningfully higher on every public benchmark (e.g., MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.1 vs 54.3), which best supports correct quantitative reasoning. Internal eval differences here are within variance, so the benchmark edge tips it to Dunlin.
